P01.rationale: A large portrait of the client (Soufian El Morabiti) occupies roughly half the left column, making it a prominent human anchor, though it functions as a client photo rather than a founder/presenter figure.

P05.rationale: The client portrait is clearly framed and named with company attribution beneath it, occupying a meaningful portion of the left column, though it is a screenshot-style image rather than a clean headshot.

P07.rationale: There is no press/logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus beyond the single inline pull-quote; no structured social-proof block is present.

P10.rationale: A large opening quotation mark glyph appears before the testimonial block, but there are no giant ghost numerals or other oversized decorative typographic elements.

P11.rationale: A before/after horizontal bar chart comparing 8 months vs. 2 months is present and bound to real numeric data, providing genuine data visualisation.

P12.rationale: The layout is reasonably well-filled with structured sections (situation, solution, result, chart, stats, quote), though the right column has some open breathing room that keeps it from feeling fully magazine-dense.

P13.rationale: The background is a warm off-white/cream tone rather than flat white, providing a subtle atmospheric quality, but there is no real texture or photographic atmosphere.

P14.rationale: The portrait photo has a slight notification overlay element but no full-bleed treatment; text is not placed over the photo, so readability is maintained without needing a scrim.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) is shown anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The portrait appears to be a real, specific person (named client) in a recognisable setting, reducing generic stock feel, though the image style has a slightly produced/video-thumbnail quality.

N08.rationale: There is some open whitespace in the lower right area and between sections, but it is not excessive or purposeless — it serves as breathing room between structured content blocks.

N10.rationale: No text is placed directly over the busy photo; the image and text occupy separate, clearly delineated zones with no awkward overlaps.
